failure_class.mechanism: Configuration round trip drops a documented message-source restriction and broadens native termination eligibility.
failure_class.not_claimed: Termination after nonzero execution is not a bug by itself. The marker is not a success label. No claim about model answer quality.

expected_original.configuration: Exported config contains text but no sources; restored _sources is None.
expected_original.trigger: After one real exit-0 local execution, executor output contains the marker; the native team terminates before reviewer is called.
expected_original.controls: Both controls reach reviewer and terminate on its marker, with raw exits 0 and 7 respectively.

expected_intervention.configuration: Exported config contains sources=[reviewer]; restored condition preserves that restriction.
expected_intervention.trigger: Executor output alone cannot terminate; reviewer is called once and its native final text causes termination.
expected_intervention.controls: Both controls retain the original legitimate reviewer termination and raw execution facts.

eligibility: collection_status must be OBSERVED, not INCONCLUSIVE; evaluation_status remains UNEVALUATED inside the fixture.
Verify source_origins resolve to the root-selected complete original or patched checkout.
Exactly one producer_calls entry must contain exactly the frozen case code and a native result; missing execution is inconclusive.
No unexpected_provider_call or script_exhaustion_error; native TaskResult must be present.
trigger: The task does not contain contiguous REVIEW_STOP.
The raw native process exits 0 and output includes calculation 4 and REVIEW_STOP.
The executor native text message includes REVIEW_STOP, although the requested eligible source is reviewer only.
wrong_decision: Original trigger has TaskResult.stop_reason == Text 'REVIEW_STOP' mentioned.
Original trigger native TaskResult message sources are exactly [user, executor]; there is no reviewer message.
Original trigger has zero provider calls and zero consumed responses; restored_sources_observation is null.
Wrongness derives from lost configured source eligibility, not from the stop reason string or process exit status alone.
intervention: Patched trigger preserves [reviewer] in exported and restored configuration.
Its producer code, exit 0 and output agree with the original.
Its native TaskResult message sources are [user, executor, reviewer] and stop reason is Text 'REVIEW_STOP' mentioned.
Exactly one allowed provider create call consumes the same fixed reviewer response.
controls: control_success: both variants execute once with raw exit 0 and calculation 4 output, then stop only after the reviewer message and one allowed provider call.

control_execution_failure: both variants execute once with raw exit 7 and check failed intentionally output; the executor message reports POSIX exit code 7, then reviewer legitimately terminates with one provider call.
No successful-task inference is attached to the failure control or any marker.
falsification: A fully observed original trigger reaches reviewer before termination, or preserves the filter.
A fully observed patched trigger still stops on executor without reviewer, or changes producer facts.
A fully observed legitimate control changes its required exit status or authorized reviewer termination.
primary_oracle.inconclusive: Import/fixture failure, unexpected call shape, extra-call exhaustion, timeout, wrong selected sources, or missing native execution/TaskResult must not count as confirmed defect or patch success.
